summary: Recommends splitting automation into smaller reusable files so variables, tasks and plays can be reused across playbooks and maintained in one place.
questions: Should I split a large playbook into smaller files?
How do I reuse the same tasks across multiple playbooks?

answer_card.title: Why reuse Ansible artifacts
answer_card.answer_md: Breaking automation into smaller files (task files, roles, etc.) lets you reuse the same variables, tasks and plays in many playbooks, or several times in one, while maintaining them in a single place. For example, put database-update tasks in a tasks file or role and reuse them everywhere.
